author: (Guilding, 1828)

note.en: A tiny brackish-water snail of coastal lagoons, known here from INBio samples in the Gandoca sector, at the surface and at 10 m. The other records are from freshwater streams inland.
note.es: Un caracol diminuto de agua salobre en lagunas costeras, conocido aquí por muestras del INBio en el sector Gandoca, en superficie y a 10 m. Los demás registros son de quebradas de agua dulce tierra adentro.

evidence: GBIF: 8 museum specimens (INBio), Gandoca sector and Hitoy Cerere, 1993 to 2000

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records for the region box (INBio Atta collection, iNaturalist)

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 8 museum specimens (INBio), Gandoca sector and Hitoy Cerere, 1993 to 2000.

marks.en: Tiny, slender, pointed brown shell a few millimetres long, found in brackish water.
marks.es: Concha diminuta, delgada y puntiaguda, de color pardo, de pocos milimetros; vive en agua salobre.
